sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: It was around 2am on a dreary night in 1899 when 22-year-old Karl Tanzler was awoken by the feeling that he was being watched.
sentences.zh: 那是1899年一个阴沉的夜晚，大约凌晨两点，22岁的卡尔·坦兹勒从睡梦中惊醒，感觉有人在注视着他。

sentences.en: A budding young scientist, Karl lived in his family's estate, the Villa Kossel, just outside Dresden, Germany.
sentences.zh: 作为一名初出茅庐的年轻科学家，卡尔住在德国德累斯顿郊外家族的科塞尔庄园里。

sentences.en: According to his mother, the estate had previously belonged to their ancestor, Countess Anna Constantia von Kossel,
sentences.zh: 据他母亲说，这座庄园曾属于他们的祖先——安娜·康斯坦蒂亚·冯·科塞尔伯爵夫人，
zh_words: 安娜·康斯坦蒂亚·冯·科塞尔伯爵

sentences.en: a German noblewoman and mistress of Augustus the Strong, King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania.
sentences.zh: 她是一位德国贵族，也是波兰国王兼立陶宛大公奥古斯都二世的情妇。

sentences.en: Although the Countess died in 1765, several members of the Tanzler family had reported seeing her ghost roaming the halls at night, her long hair glowing white in the darkness.
sentences.zh: 尽管伯爵夫人于1765年去世，但坦兹勒家族的几位成员曾报告说，看到她的鬼魂在夜间游荡，她那长长的头发在黑暗中闪烁着白光。

sentences.en: Karl didn't believe in the supernatural, choosing instead to focus on the scientific.
sentences.zh: 卡尔并不相信超自然现象，他更倾向于专注于科学研究。

sentences.en: He often stayed up until all hours tinkering in his laboratory.
sentences.zh: 他经常熬夜到深夜，在实验室里摆弄各种仪器。

sentences.en: But over the past few nights, he'd observed several strange phenomena.
sentences.zh: 但在过去几个晚上，他观察到了一些奇怪的现象。

sentences.en: The first happened while he was working at his desk.
sentences.zh: 第一件事发生在他伏案工作时。

sentences.en: Just outside of his field of vision, he saw a pencil levitating.
sentences.zh: 就在视野余光中，他看到一支铅笔悬浮了起来。

sentences.en: When he turned to look at it, the pencil dropped suddenly to the ground.
sentences.zh: 当他转头看去时，铅笔突然掉在了地上。

sentences.en: This was soon followed by furniture that slid across the room as if pushed by invisible hands and glass plates that shattered without so much as a touch.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，家具仿佛被无形的手推动，在房间里滑动，玻璃盘子甚至没被触碰就碎裂了。

sentences.en: Karl was intrigued, but not frightened, believing it was some kind of prank or that there was a thief or prowler in the house.
sentences.zh: 卡尔感到好奇，但并不害怕，他认为这只是一种恶作剧，或者家里进了小偷或潜行者。

sentences.en: But all that changed when he opened his eyes that night to find the figures of two women standing at the foot of his bed, their skin translucent like water.
sentences.zh: 但当他那天晚上睁开眼，发现床脚站着两个女人，她们的皮肤像水一样透明时，一切都变了。

sentences.en: He immediately recognised one of them as his ancestor, the Countess Anna Constantia von Cozzel.
sentences.zh: 他立刻认出其中一人是他的祖先，安娜·康斯坦蒂亚·冯·科塞尔伯爵夫人。
zh_words: 安娜·康斯坦蒂亚·冯·科塞尔伯爵

sentences.en: Beside her stood a younger woman, her face hidden behind what appeared to be a bridal veil.
sentences.zh: 在她身边站着一位年轻女子，脸被似乎是婚纱面纱的东西遮住了。

sentences.en: Karl sat motionless as the Countess grabbed the younger woman by the hand and presented her to him.
sentences.zh: 卡尔一动不动地坐着，看着伯爵夫人抓住那年轻女子的手，将她介绍给自己。

sentences.en: I've been trying to get your attention for some time, the Countess said.
sentences.zh: “我一直在试图引起你的注意，”伯爵夫人说。

sentences.en: Look here, Karl.
sentences.zh: “看这里，卡尔。”

sentences.en: I have brought you the bride whom someday you will meet.
sentences.zh: “我把你未来终将相遇的新娘带来了。”

sentences.en: Karl opened his mouth to reply, but no words came out.
sentences.zh: 卡尔张开嘴想回答，却发不出声音。

sentences.en: For a fleeting second, the young, dark-haired beauty smiled at him.
sentences.zh: 在那短暂的一瞬间，那位年轻的黑发美女对他笑了笑。

sentences.en: Then, just as quickly as she and her ghostly companion had appeared, they vanished, leaving him alone in his bed.
sentences.zh: 然后，她和她的幽灵同伴就像出现时一样迅速消失了，只留下他独自躺在床上。

sentences.en: Karl was mystified, but not disturbed by the encounter.
sentences.zh: 卡尔感到困惑，但并没有因为这次相遇而感到不安。

sentences.en: On the contrary, he found it to be wonderful.
sentences.zh: 相反，他觉得这非常美妙。

sentences.en: He noted the time and then fell back into a sound sleep.
sentences.zh: 他记下了时间，然后又沉沉睡去。

sentences.en: Although Karl Tanzler got on with his life, he never forgot this otherworldly encounter.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡尔·坦兹勒继续过着自己的生活，但他从未忘记这次超凡的邂逅。

sentences.en: He eventually got married, had two daughters, and took on the surname von Cozzel before immigrating to the United States in 1926.
sentences.zh: 他最终结了婚，有了两个女儿，并改姓“冯·科塞尔”，随后于1926年移民到美国。

sentences.en: Karl and his family moved in with his sister in the Florida city of Zephyrhills, where he struggled to find work in the dwindling job market.
sentences.zh: 卡尔和家人搬到了佛罗里达州泽弗希尔斯市与他姐姐同住，他在那里难以在萎缩的就业市场中找到工作。

sentences.en: Practically destitute, Karl moved 445 miles south, seeking employment at the Marine Hospital in Key WeSt.
sentences.zh: 几乎身无分文的卡尔向南搬了445英里，在基韦斯特的海军医院寻找工作。

sentences.en: The three-storey facility featured specialised wards for infectious diseases and was the only hospital for several miles.
sentences.zh: 这家三层楼的设施设有专门的传染病病房，是方圆几英里内唯一的医院。

sentences.en: For that reason, it was open to the general public, not just military personnel.
sentences.zh: 因此，它不仅对军事人员开放，也对公众开放。

sentences.en: As a young man growing up in Germany, Karl had been fascinated by the various sciences,
sentences.zh: 作为在德国长大的年轻人，卡尔一直对各种科学着迷，

sentences.en: and claimed to have nine degrees from the University of Leipzig, one of the country's oldest and most respected medical institutions.
sentences.zh: 并声称拥有莱比锡大学的九个学位，那是该国最古老、最受尊敬的医学机构之一。

sentences.en: These apparently included a Master of Arts in Medicine, as well as additional degrees in Philosophy, Mathematics, Astronomy, Physics, Engineering, and Chemistry.
sentences.zh: 这些学位显然包括医学硕士学位，以及哲学、数学、天文学、物理学、工程学和化学等其他学位。

sentences.en: Karl accepted a job as an attendant, which involved cleaning up after surgeries.
sentences.zh: 卡尔接受了一份护理员的工作，负责手术后的清理工作。

sentences.en: But it didn't take long for him to distinguish himself, and eventually he was allowed to operate medical machinery and deal with patients.
sentences.zh: 但他很快就脱颖而出，最终被允许操作医疗器械并处理病人。

sentences.en: By 1930, 53-year-old Karl was working as a radiology technician.
sentences.zh: 到1930年，53岁的卡尔已成为一名放射科技术员。

sentences.en: Every month, he sent a small stipend back to his wife and daughters in Zephyrhills.
sentences.zh: 每个月，他都会寄一小笔生活费回泽弗希尔斯给他的妻子和女儿。

sentences.en: The morning of Tuesday, April 22, 1930, started out like any other for Karl.
sentences.zh: 1930年4月22日，星期二的早晨，对卡尔来说和往常一样。

sentences.en: He was informed by the head office that there was a young woman waiting to have some blood samples and x-rays taken.
sentences.zh: 办公室通知他，有一位年轻女子在等候，需要进行血液采样和X光检查。

sentences.en: The patient was Alina Malagro Hoyas, a 20-year-old who had recently been diagnosed with tuberculosis.
sentences.zh: 病人是艾琳娜·马拉格罗·奥约斯，一名刚被诊断出患有肺结核的20岁女子。
zh_words: 艾琳娜·马拉格罗·奥约斯

sentences.en: The deadliest disease in human history, tuberculosis, also known as consumption or the White Plague,
sentences.zh: 肺结核是人类历史上最致命的疾病，也被称为“消耗症”或“白色瘟疫”，

sentences.en: is a bacterial infection that attacks the lungs, causing chest pain, persistent cough, fever, weight loss, and fatigue.
sentences.zh: 这是一种攻击肺部的细菌感染，会导致胸痛、持续咳嗽、发烧、体重减轻和疲劳。

sentences.en: Throughout the first half of the 20th century, it was the leading cause of death among young people in the United States, accounting for roughly 11% of all fatalities.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪上半叶，它是美国年轻人死亡的主要原因，约占所有死亡人数的11%。

sentences.en: The year Alina Malagro Hoyas was diagnosed, nearly 85,000 Americans died of the disease.
sentences.zh: 在艾琳娜·马拉格罗·奥约斯被确诊的那一年，近8.5万名美国人死于这种疾病。
zh_words: 艾琳娜·马拉格罗·奥约斯

sentences.en: Today, tuberculosis is largely curable, but in the 1920s and 30s, it ravaged Florida's immigrant communities.
sentences.zh: 如今，肺结核在很大程度上是可以治愈的，但在20世纪20和30年代，它肆虐了佛罗里达州的移民社区。

sentences.en: Alina's parents had immigrated to the United States from Cuba decades earlier, hoping to build a better life for themselves and their three daughters.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜的父母几十年前从古巴移民到美国，希望能为自己和三个女儿创造更好的生活。

sentences.en: Her father worked in a cigar factory, where the dense, crowded conditions, coupled with the close-knit nature of immigrant housing, facilitated the rapid spread of the disease.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲在一家雪茄工厂工作，那里密集拥挤的环境，加上移民住房紧密相连的特点，加速了疾病的迅速传播。

sentences.en: When Alina first started showing symptoms of tuberculosis, her family didn't realise the signs.
sentences.zh: 当艾琳娜最初出现肺结核症状时，她的家人并没有意识到这些迹象。

sentences.en: Alina was one of three sisters in a boisterous Cuban-American household, and she'd grown up surrounded by good food and lively conversation.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜是一个热闹的古巴裔美国家庭中三个姐妹之一，她在美食和欢声笑语中长大。

sentences.en: With raven black hair and deep brown eyes, many thought she looked like a movie star.
sentences.zh: 她有着乌黑的头发和深褐色的眼睛，许多人认为她长得像电影明星。

sentences.en: Throughout her teenage years, Alina was inundated with Sousa's, yet she only had eyes for one man, Luis Massa.
sentences.zh: 在整个青少年时期，艾琳娜追求者不断，但她眼里只有一个人，路易斯·马萨。

sentences.en: Their courtship was quick and intense, and they got married in February 1926.
sentences.zh: 他们的恋爱过程迅速而热烈，并于1926年2月结婚。

sentences.en: When the couple discovered they were pregnant just a few months later, they were elated.
sentences.zh: 当这对夫妇几个月后发现怀孕时，他们欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Alina had always wanted to be a mother.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜一直想成为一名母亲。

sentences.en: But, several months into Alina's pregnancy, her health began to deteriorate, and she suffered a devastating miscarriage.
sentences.zh: 但是，在艾琳娜怀孕几个月后，她的健康状况开始恶化，并遭遇了毁灭性的流产。

sentences.en: After that, Luis became cold and distant, which devastated Alina.
sentences.zh: 此后，路易斯变得冷漠疏远，这让艾琳娜深受打击。

sentences.en: In the months that followed, she lost a significant amount of weight, her once radiant complexion turning sickly and pale.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，她体重明显下降，曾经红润的肤色变得病态苍白。

sentences.en: Her family initially dismissed these changes as the ravages of grief, but as the months turned into years, they began to fear something far more insidious had taken hold of Alina.
sentences.zh: 她的家人起初认为这些变化是悲伤带来的折磨，但随着时间推移，他们开始担心某种更阴险的东西缠上了艾琳娜。

sentences.en: In April 1930, her physician diagnosed her with tuberculosis, and to determine the severity of Alina's infection,
sentences.zh: 1930年4月，她的医生诊断她患有肺结核，为了确定艾琳娜感染的严重程度，

sentences.en: scheduled an appointment for her at the Marine Hospital in Key WeSt.
sentences.zh: 为她在基韦斯特的海军医院预约了检查。

sentences.en: Dr Marion Lombard, the physician in charge, had successfully battled the bubonic plague while working in New Orleans 15 years earlier,
sentences.zh: 负责的医生马里昂·隆巴德博士，15年前在纽奥良工作时曾成功对抗过鼠疫，

sentences.en: giving the Hoyas family hope that he would be able to cure Alina.
sentences.zh: 这让奥约斯一家燃起了希望，认为他能治好艾琳娜。

sentences.en: On the day of her appointment, Alina was escorted to an exam room while her husband, Luis, waited outside.
sentences.zh: 预约当天，艾琳娜被护送进检查室，而她的丈夫路易斯在外面等候。

sentences.en: When Carl Tanzler entered the room to begin the blood work, he couldn't believe what he was seeing.
sentences.zh: 当卡尔·坦兹勒走进房间开始验血时，他简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: Sitting before him was the woman who had come to him during that vision all those years earlier.
sentences.zh: 坐在他面前的，正是多年前在幻象中向他显现的那个女人。

sentences.en: It was the bride who had been promised to him by his ancestor.
sentences.zh: 那是他的祖先许诺给他的新娘。

sentences.en: Carl was so struck by Alina, he could hardly speak.
sentences.zh: 卡尔被艾琳娜深深吸引，几乎说不出话来。

sentences.en: For over 30 years, he'd lived every day with the thought of his promised bride in mind.
sentences.zh: 三十多年来，他每天都带着对这位许诺新娘的思念生活。

sentences.en: At long last, they were face to face.
sentences.zh: 终于，他们面对面了。

sentences.en: When Carl read Alina's chart and saw that she was married, it felt like he'd been slapped in the face.
sentences.zh: 当卡尔读到艾琳娜的病历，看到她已婚时，感觉就像被人扇了一记耳光。

sentences.en: Although Carl, too, was married, he viewed his wife of nearly 10 years as a placeholder, someone to tide him over while he waited for his true love to appear.
sentences.zh: 虽然卡尔也已婚，但他将结婚近10年的妻子视为一个替代品，一个在他等待真爱出现期间陪伴他的人。

sentences.en: He'd told himself that Alina's husband, Luis, must be a placeholder, too.
sentences.zh: 他告诉自己，艾琳娜的丈夫路易斯肯定也只是个替代品。

sentences.en: With this explanation in mind,
sentences.zh: 带着这种解释，

sentences.en: Carl made a promise to himself.
sentences.zh: 卡尔对自己许下了一个承诺。

sentences.en: He'd save Alina's life and claim her for himself.
sentences.zh: 他要挽救艾琳娜的生命，并让她成为自己的人。

sentences.en: The following day, he administered a chest x-ray to determine whether Alina had developed lesions on her lungs.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他为艾琳娜进行了胸部X光检查，以确定她的肺部是否出现了病变。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the results confirmed his worst fear.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，结果证实了他最担心的事。

sentences.en: Not only was she suffering from tuberculosis, but it was a particularly virulent and fast-acting strain of the virus referred to as hasty consumption.
sentences.zh: 她不仅患有肺结核，而且是一种被称为“急速消耗症”的特别剧烈且快速发展的病毒株。

sentences.en: With no effective pharmaceutical cure, it was unlikely that Alina would survive the year.
sentences.zh: 由于没有有效的药物治疗，艾琳娜很难活过这一年。

sentences.en: Carl delivered the bad news to Alina and her family, explaining that the hospital wasn't adequately equipped to handle a case as dire as hers.
sentences.zh: 卡尔向艾琳娜和她的家人传达了这个坏消息，解释说医院没有足够的设备来处理像她这样严重的病例。

sentences.en: However, he explained that over the past few years, he'd developed his own equipment for treating tuberculosis.
sentences.zh: 然而，他解释说，过去几年里，他已经开发了自己的肺结核治疗设备。

sentences.en: If Alina was willing to trust him, he'd promised he'd do everything in his power to save her from this hideous disease.
sentences.zh: 如果艾琳娜愿意相信他，他承诺会尽一切努力将她从这种可怕的疾病中拯救出来。

sentences.en: Given their financial situation, the Hoyos family didn't have many options when it came to Alina's care, so they agreed to let the self-proclaimed Count Carl Von Kozel treat her.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他们的经济状况，奥约斯一家在艾琳娜的护理方面没有太多选择，所以他们同意让自称卡尔·冯·科塞尔伯爵的人为她治疗。

sentences.en: He began by administering radiation therapy at the hospital, supervised by head physician Dr Lombard.
sentences.zh: 他在主治医师隆巴德博士的监督下，开始在医院为她进行放射治疗。

sentences.en: Carl also gave Alina kinesol, adrenaline, glucose and beef extract.
sentences.zh: 卡尔还给艾琳娜服用了动能素、肾上腺素、葡萄糖和牛肉提取物。

sentences.en: At the time, doctors believed that kinesol, a chemical compound with powerful antiseptic properties, could act directly on the tubercle bacillus in the bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 当时，医生们认为动能素这种具有强大防腐性能的化学化合物，可以直接作用于血液中的结核杆菌。

sentences.en: Adrenaline, on the other hand, was used to relieve pulmonary diseases such as asthma, bronchitis and emphysema, so Carl hoped it would work on tuberculosis as well.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，肾上腺素被用于缓解哮喘、支气管炎和肺气肿等肺部疾病，所以卡尔希望它对肺结核也有效。

sentences.en: It was during this time that Alina's husband,
sentences.zh: 正是在这段时间里，艾琳娜的丈夫，

sentences.en: Luis Massa, decided he could no longer stand by and risk contracting tuberculosis himself.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·马萨，决定他不能再袖手旁观，冒着自己感染肺结核的风险。

sentences.en: In Alina's hour of need, he abandoned her for another woman and fled to Miami.
sentences.zh: 在艾琳娜最需要的时候，他为了另一个女人抛弃了她，逃往迈阿密。

sentences.en: This abandonment weighed heavily on Alina's heart, magnifying her symptoms and diminishing her strength.
sentences.zh: 这种抛弃沉重地压在艾琳娜心头，加剧了她的症状，削弱了她的体力。

sentences.en: Carl pretended to be upset on her behalf, but in reality, he was thrilled.
sentences.zh: 卡尔假装为她感到难过，但实际上他欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: To cheer Alina up, he showered her with expensive gifts, including a pearl necklace, a new radio, a silk kimono, a mahogany bed, and even a diamond ring.
sentences.zh: 为了让艾琳娜高兴，他送给她昂贵的礼物，包括珍珠项链、新收音机、丝绸和服、红木床，甚至还有一枚钻戒。

sentences.en: Despite Carl's attention, Alina's condition continued to worsen, and the Hoyos family began to question if he truly was the miracle worker he claimed to be.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡尔百般呵护，艾琳娜的病情仍在持续恶化，奥约斯一家开始怀疑他是否真的是他所声称的奇迹创造者。

sentences.en: Having grown tired of his condescending attitude and covetousness toward their daughter,
sentences.zh: 由于厌倦了他傲慢的态度以及对他们女儿的觊觎，

sentences.en: Alina's parents sought a second opinion from another doctor in town.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜的父母寻求了镇上另一位医生的第二意见。

sentences.en: Carl was infuriated.
sentences.zh: 卡尔被激怒了。

sentences.en: He claimed that the other doctor administered a series of injections that left Alina trembling and gasping for air,
sentences.zh: 他声称另一位医生进行了一系列注射，导致艾琳娜颤抖并喘不过气来，

sentences.en: yet her parents refused to let her return to the marine hospital.
sentences.zh: 但她的父母拒绝让她回到海军医院。

sentences.en: Instead, they filled their home with family, music, and food, hoping the presence of Alina's favourite things would improve her prognosis.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们让家里充满了家人、音乐和食物，希望艾琳娜喜欢的东西能改善她的预后。

sentences.en: But as the weeks wore on, Alina began to develop a dry cough, which was exacerbated by the humid Key West weather
sentences.zh: 但随着几周过去，艾琳娜开始出现干咳，这被基韦斯特潮湿的天气所加剧，

sentences.en: and the smoke that seemed to permanently hang around the cigar district like a dark cloud.
sentences.zh: 还有那似乎永远笼罩在雪茄区上空、像乌云一样的烟雾。

sentences.en: Carl felt the only way to save Alina was to get her away from her family,
sentences.zh: 卡尔觉得挽救艾琳娜的唯一方法就是让她远离家人，

sentences.en: Under this pretext, he asked her to marry him, but she turned him down, reasoning that she and Luis were still married in the eyes of God.
sentences.zh: 以此为借口，他向她求婚，但她拒绝了他，理由是她和路易斯在上帝眼中仍然是夫妻。

sentences.en: Carl continued to pursue Alina regardless, saying they were destined to be together.
sentences.zh: 卡尔不顾一切地继续追求艾琳娜，说他们注定要在一起。

sentences.en: He even told her about his youthful encounter with the ghost of Anna Constantia von Cozzel, explaining that Alina had been searching for him since before she was even born.
sentences.zh: 他甚至告诉她自己年轻时与安娜·康斯坦蒂亚·冯·科塞尔鬼魂相遇的经历，解释说艾琳娜在出生前就一直在寻找他。
zh_words: 安娜·康斯坦蒂亚·冯·科塞尔

sentences.en: As Alina's 21st birthday came and went, it became clear to the Hoyos family that her death was inevitable.
sentences.zh: 随着艾琳娜21岁生日的到来，奥约斯一家清楚地意识到她的死亡已不可避免。

sentences.en: They sought advice from several more doctors, but all were pessimistic about her chances of recovery.
sentences.zh: 他们又咨询了几位医生，但所有人都对她的康复前景持悲观态度。

sentences.en: Alina had grown too weak to journey back and forth from the hospital, so Carl resolved to treat her in-house.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜已经虚弱得无法往返医院，所以卡尔决定在家里为她治疗。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, he wheeled several strange contraptions into her bedroom, including a homemade electrical therapy machine
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，他把几台奇怪的装置推进了她的卧室，包括一台自制的电疗机，

sentences.en: that looked like a prop from a science fiction film.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像科幻电影里的道具。

sentences.en: According to author Ben Harrison, who wrote the definitive book on Alina's case,
sentences.zh: 据撰写了关于艾琳娜案件权威书籍的作家本·哈里森所说，

sentences.en: Carl placed sponge electrodes on Alina's chest and shocked her until she literally jolted.
sentences.zh: 卡尔把海绵电极放在艾琳娜的胸口，电击她直到她身体剧烈抽搐。

sentences.en: When the electricity surging through her body became too much to bear, she'd cry out in pain.
sentences.zh: 当流经她身体的电流变得难以忍受时，她会痛苦地尖叫。

sentences.en: Only then would Carl allow her to reSt.
sentences.zh: 只有那时，卡尔才会让她休息。

sentences.en: Carl still believed he could save Alina and often regaled her with fantastic stories of all the adventures that go on once she was well again.
sentences.zh: 卡尔仍然相信他能救艾琳娜，并经常给她讲一些奇妙的故事，描述她康复后将要经历的所有冒险。

sentences.en: Several years earlier, he'd begun restoring a small wingless airplane in the Navy Yard behind the Marine Hospital.
sentences.zh: 几年前，他开始在海军医院后面的海军造船厂修复一架无翼飞机。

sentences.en: As soon as he finished working on it, he told Alina that they would fly to a distant island and live out the remainder of their days as husband and wife.
sentences.zh: 他告诉艾琳娜，一旦修好，他们就会飞到一个遥远的岛屿，以夫妻身份度过余生。

sentences.en: According to Carl,
sentences.zh: 据卡尔说，

sentences.en: Alina shared his vision of a future together and made him promise that he would never abandon her.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜和他有着共同的未来愿景，并让他发誓永远不会抛弃她。

sentences.en: She allegedly told him,
sentences.zh: 据称她告诉他，

sentences.en: If I must die, all I can leave you is my body.
sentences.zh: “如果我必须死，我能留给你的只有我的身体。”

sentences.en: You will take care of my body after I am dead, won't you?
sentences.zh: “我死后，你会照顾我的身体，对吗？”

sentences.en: Carl swore that he would, calling it, quote,
sentences.zh: 卡尔发誓他会做到，并称之为，引用，

sentences.en: The most sacred promise I ever made in life.
sentences.zh: “我一生中做出的最神圣的承诺。”

sentences.en: By the autumn of 1931,
sentences.zh: 到1931年秋天，

sentences.en: Alina Malagro Hoyas was in poor shape.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜·马拉格罗·奥约斯的身体状况已经很糟糕了。

sentences.en: She spent most days drifting in and out of consciousness and have a present fever confining her to her room.
sentences.zh: 她大部分时间都在昏迷中度过，持续的高烧将她困在房间里。

sentences.en: Believing some fresh air would do her good, her father, Francisco, started taking her for rides around town in a borrowed Ford Model T.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲弗朗西斯科认为呼吸新鲜空气对她有好处，于是开始借了一辆福特T型车带她在城里兜风。

sentences.en: Carl Tanzler was furious, convinced that being exposed to the elements would hurt her chances of recovery.
sentences.zh: 卡尔·坦兹勒大发雷霆，坚信暴露在户外会损害她康复的机会。

sentences.en: He expressed his concerns to Francisco, but if Alina was going to die, her family wanted her to experience what little joy she had left.
sentences.zh: 他向弗朗西斯科表达了自己的担忧，但如果艾琳娜注定要死，她的家人希望她能体验剩下的那一点点快乐。

sentences.en: For the next few weeks,
sentences.zh: 接下来的几周里，

sentences.en: Francisco continued to take his daughter on daily outings in an attempt to lift her spirits.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯科继续每天带女儿出去兜风，试图提振她的精神。

sentences.en: Then, on October 25, just as Carl was getting ready to leave work for the day, a car screeched into the hospital parking lot.
sentences.zh: 然后，在10月25日，就在卡尔准备下班离开时，一辆汽车尖叫着冲进了医院停车场。

sentences.en: Behind the wheel was Alina's brother-in-law, Mario.
sentences.zh: 开车的是艾琳娜的姐夫马里奥。

sentences.en: With tears in his eyes, he told Carl to come quickly.
sentences.zh: 他含着泪告诉卡尔快点过去。

sentences.en: Alina had just died.
sentences.zh: 艾琳娜刚刚去世了。

sentences.en: By the time they arrived at the Hoyos home, a large crowd had already gathered outside.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达霍约斯家时，外面已经聚集了一大群人。

sentences.en: Carl and Mario made their way into Alina's bedroom to find her cold and unresponsive.
sentences.zh: 卡尔和马里奥走进阿琳娜的卧室，发现她身体冰冷，毫无反应。

sentences.en: Mario explained that Francisco had allowed Alina to attend the town's annual Halloween parade.
sentences.zh: 马里奥解释说，弗朗西斯科曾允许阿琳娜参加镇上一年一度的万圣节游行。

sentences.en: She had insisted on wearing her favourite silk dress and several pieces of jewellery, waving to all the friends she encountered along the parade route.
sentences.zh: 她坚持要穿上她最喜欢的丝绸连衣裙，戴上几件首饰，并向游行沿途遇到的所有朋友挥手致意。

sentences.en: It was, as Carl begrudgingly admitted, a farewell fit for a princess.
sentences.zh: 正如卡尔勉强承认的那样，这是一场适合公主的告别仪式。

sentences.en: Alina's funeral was held at the Hoyos residence that Sunday and attended by scores of friends, family and neighbours, many of whom laid flowers outside the bedroom
sentences.zh: 那个周日，阿琳娜的葬礼在霍约斯家中举行，许多亲朋好友和邻居前来参加，其中许多人在卧室外献了花，

sentences.en: where Alina had taken her last breath.
sentences.zh: 那是阿琳娜最后一次呼吸的地方。

sentences.en: Just before her coffin was closed,
sentences.zh: 就在棺材盖上之前，

sentences.en: Carl took a letter from his breast pocket and placed it beneath her dress.
sentences.zh: 卡尔从胸前的口袋里掏出一封信，放在了她的裙子下面。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 信上写着：

sentences.en: Alina, my darling Alina, my love for you is greater than ever.
sentences.zh: 阿琳娜，我亲爱的阿琳娜，我对你的爱比以往任何时候都更深。

sentences.en: You are now free from all of your fetters and you are free to go where you wish.
sentences.zh: 你现在已经摆脱了所有的束缚，可以自由地去任何你想去的地方了。

sentences.en: Alina, please come to me, sweetheart.
sentences.zh: 阿琳娜，请到我这里来，亲爱的。

sentences.en: I long so much for you.
sentences.zh: 我太渴望你了。

sentences.en: Tell me, what shall I do, as I cannot live without you?
sentences.zh: 告诉我，我该怎么办？没有你我无法活下去。

sentences.en: Will you have me, darling?
sentences.zh: 你愿意接受我吗，亲爱的？

sentences.en: Then take me, or you come to me and stay with me until I can go with you, my sweetheart,
sentences.zh: 那就带我走，或者你到我这里来，留在我身边，直到我能和你在一起，我的爱人，

sentences.en: Alina.
sentences.zh: 阿琳娜。

sentences.en: Your own Carl.
sentences.zh: 你自己的卡尔。

sentences.en: Wanting to feel closer to Alina,
sentences.zh: 为了感觉离阿琳娜更近一些，

sentences.en: Carl soon began renting her vacant bedroom and sleeping in the same bed she'd died in just weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 卡尔很快开始租下她那间空置的卧室，并睡在她几周前去世时躺的那张床上。

sentences.en: Although the Hoyos family was unhappy with the arrangement, they couldn't justify turning down the $5 in monthly rent Carl was offering.
sentences.zh: 尽管霍约斯一家对这种安排很不满，但他们无法拒绝卡尔每月支付的5美元租金。

sentences.en: As long as Carl kept to himself,
sentences.zh: 只要卡尔安分守己，

sentences.en: Alina's parents saw no reason to kick him out.
sentences.zh: 阿琳娜的父母就找不到理由把他赶走。

sentences.en: Carl was worried that the shallow grave Alina had been buried in would fail to adequately protect her from the elements,
sentences.zh: 卡尔担心阿琳娜被埋葬的浅坟无法让她免受风雨侵蚀，

sentences.en: so he proposed building a grand mausoleum to house her body.
sentences.zh: 于是他提议建造一座宏伟的陵墓来安放她的遗体。

sentences.en: He offered to pay for the construction and upkeep on one condition.
sentences.zh: 他提出支付建造和维护费用，但有一个条件。

sentences.en: He would need to be placed in charge of Alina's remains.
sentences.zh: 他必须负责保管阿琳娜的遗骸。

sentences.en: Although Alina's parents were unsure at first, they eventually relented.
sentences.zh: 虽然阿琳娜的父母起初有些犹豫，但最终还是同意了。

sentences.en: Carl began working on the project, securing a permit to remove Alina from her current resting place and have her reinterred in an above-ground crypt.
sentences.zh: 卡尔开始着手这个项目，并获得了将阿琳娜从现有的安息地移出，重新安葬在地上墓穴的许可。

sentences.en: Alina's body was soaked with rainwater and had been partially crushed beneath the shovel of a gravedigger.
sentences.zh: 阿琳娜的遗体被雨水浸透，并且在掘墓人的铲子下部分受损。

sentences.en: When Carl saw it, he decided that Alina would need to be re-bedded.
sentences.zh: 当卡尔看到这一幕时，他决定需要为阿琳娜重新整理遗体。

sentences.en: In most cases, re-bedding consists of replacing a coffin's interior linens or adjusting its mattress to better accommodate the deceased.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，重新整理遗体包括更换棺材内的衬布或调整床垫，以使逝者躺得更舒适。

sentences.en: In Alina's case, a complete sterilisation of both her body and coffin were performed.
sentences.zh: 而在阿琳娜的案例中，她的遗体和棺材都进行了彻底的消毒。

sentences.en: Knowing the Hoyos family would view this as sacrilege,
sentences.zh: 因为知道霍约斯一家会认为这是亵渎，

sentences.en: Carl snuck into the funeral home in the middle of the night to work in private.
sentences.zh: 卡尔在深夜潜入殡仪馆私下工作。

sentences.en: Later writing about this experience in his memoir,
sentences.zh: 后来在回忆录中写到这段经历时，

sentences.en: Carl said,
sentences.zh: 卡尔说：

sentences.en: Decay had set in in a most disheartening manner.
sentences.zh: 腐烂以一种最令人沮丧的方式开始了。

sentences.en: Only with the greatest care was I able to peel the pieces of textile from the body.
sentences.zh: 我极其小心地将织物碎片从遗体上剥离下来。

sentences.en: This took hours.
sentences.zh: 这花了几个小时。

sentences.en: I then lifted the body out of the coffin and laid it on a table.
sentences.zh: 然后我把遗体从棺材里抬出来，放在桌子上。

sentences.en: Having sprayed the body all over, I now proceeded to sponge her face with a specially prepared solution and also her hands and feet.
sentences.zh: 在给遗体全身喷洒药水后，我开始用特制的溶液擦拭她的脸、手和脚。

sentences.en: Till dawn, I worked with every energy, appalled at the negligence of the mortician who had failed to embalm the coffin, which smelled awful.
sentences.zh: 直到黎明，我竭尽全力地工作，对殡仪员未能对棺材进行防腐处理感到震惊，棺材里散发着难闻的气味。

sentences.en: Carl finished by spraying eau de cologne all over Alina's body.
sentences.zh: 卡尔最后在阿琳娜的遗体上喷洒了古龙水。

sentences.en: With the mortician's help, he then placed her wooden coffin inside an airtight outer coffin made of metal and sealed with nearly a hundred screws.
sentences.zh: 在殡仪员的帮助下，他将木棺放入了一个由金属制成的气密外棺中，并用近一百颗螺丝密封。

sentences.en: Like many others, the mortician found Carl to be an off-putting individual.
sentences.zh: 像许多其他人一样，殡仪员觉得卡尔是个令人反感的人。

sentences.en: Regardless, he agreed to let Carl use the embalming room to fill Alina's coffin with an antiseptic solution intended to protect her body against further decay.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他还是同意让卡尔使用防腐室，将防腐溶液注入阿琳娜的棺材中，以保护她的遗体免受进一步腐烂。

sentences.en: According to the book
sentences.zh: 根据《不朽的爱：基韦斯特关于一段超越死亡的激情的真实震撼故事》一书，

sentences.en: Undying Love, the shocking true Key West story of a passion that defied death,
sentences.zh: 卡尔将阿琳娜的遗体浸泡在一个自制的培养罐中，就像人们将物体悬浮在福尔马林中一样。

sentences.en: Carl submerged Alina's body in a homemade incubator tank, similar to how one would suspend an object in formaldehyde.
sentences.zh: 挖掘出土三个月后，

sentences.zh: 阿琳娜·马拉格罗·霍约斯再次入土为安。

sentences.en: Alina Malagro Hoyos was once again laid to reSt.
sentences.zh: 她的陵墓被认为是整个基韦斯特最精致的陵墓之一，拥有华丽的圆顶、巨大的柱子和大理石墓碑。

sentences.en: Her mausoleum was considered one of the most elaborate in all of Key West, with an ornate dome, great pillars, and marble headstone.
sentences.zh: 建筑的四个侧面各有一个装满鲜花的水泥瓮，屋顶上装饰着一个巨大的黑色十字架。

sentences.zh: Acesitu Sabangelus，意思是

sentences.en: Acesitu Sabangelus, which meant
sentences.zh: 天使的召唤。

sentences.en: Summoned by Angels.

sentences.en: With her mausoleum finally complete, this marked the end of a long and painful journey for Alina's family, who hoped they could now move on with their lives.
sentences.zh: 阿琳娜的大姐，

sentences.en: Alina's eldest sister,

sentences.en: Florinda, who was affectionately known as Nana, visited Alina's grave regularly.
sentences.zh: 她经常带去鲜花，分享关于朋友和家人的故事，让阿琳娜了解所有发生的事情，包括他们的小妹妹的去世，

sentences.en: She often brought flowers and shared stories about their friends and family, keeping Alina up to date on all the events, including the death of their younger sister,
sentences.zh: 西莉亚，她在21岁时因肺结核去世。

sentences.en: Celia, who passed away from tuberculosis at the age of just 21.

sentences.en: Their father, Francisco, followed soon after, leaving just Nana and her mother, Aurora.

sentences.en: Nana visited the cemetery almost every day, but as time went on, her visits grew less and less frequent, eventually petering out to once or twice a year.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，卡尔·坦兹勒却从未停止过探望。

sentences.en: Carl Tanzler, on the other hand, never stopped coming.
sentences.zh: 这让娜娜感到不安。

sentences.zh: 如果阿琳娜的家人在死后都能继续生活，为什么他不能？
